title: Cisco CBS350-24T-4X-EU Gigabit Managed Switch with 4 x 10G SFP+ uplink ports

items.h: Ports: 24 x 10/100/1000 Mbps Gigabit Ethernet ports, 4 x 10G SFP+ uplink ports
16K MAC Address, 4096 VLANs, L3 Static Routes

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Enhance your office or enterprise network with the Cisco CBS350-24T-4X-EU Gigabit Managed Switch, designed for high-performance, secure, and reliable connectivity. This switch features 24 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 4 SFP uplink ports, providing flexibility and speed for growing networks. Ideal for small to medium-sized businesses, it supports advanced Layer 3 features, VLAN segmentation, and Quality of Service (QoS) to prioritize traffic efficiently.


With its intuitive web interface and Cisco Network Assistant, the CBS350-24T-4X-EU simplifies management, configuration, and monitoring while maintaining energy-efficient operation. Protect and scale your network with Cisco’s trusted technology.


Technical Specifications:

  • Model: Cisco CBS350-24T-4X-EU
  • Ports: 24 x 10/100/1000 Mbps Gigabit Ethernet ports, 4 x 10G SFP+ uplink ports
  • Switching Capacity: 128 Gbps
  • Forwarding Rate: 95.2 Mpps
  • Layer 3 Routing: Static routing, RIP v1/v2, OSPF Lite
  • VLAN Support: Up to 255 VLANs, Port-based and Protocol-based VLANs
  • QoS: Layer 2/Layer 3 QoS, traffic prioritization, bandwidth control
  • Security Features: Access Control Lists (ACLs), IEEE 802.1X port security, DHCP snooping, IP Source Guard
  • Management: Web-based GUI, Cisco Network Assistant, CLI via console
  • Redundancy & Reliability: Spanning Tree Protocol (STP/RSTP/MSTP), Link Aggregation (LACP)
  • Energy Efficiency: Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE), low-power design
  • Power Supply: Internal AC power, 100-240V, 50/60Hz
  • Dimensions: 44.5 x 29.5 x 4.4 cm
  • Weight: 4.5 kg
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C to 45°C
